query_info.key_query: SELECT A.amsysMenuId AS "docid" -- 재산관리시스템메뉴ID FROM ( SELECT AMSYS_MENU_ID AS amsysMenuId , AMSYS_BIZ_CFCD AS amsysBizCfcd , AMSYS_DTLS_CLF_ID AS amsysBizDtlsClfId , AMSYS_MENU_NM AS amsysMenuNm , AMSYS_MENU_MARK_SEQ AS amsysMenuMarkSeq , AMSYS_HGRN_MENU_ID AS amsysHgrnMenuId , AMSYS_MENU_HDN_YN AS amsysMenuHdnYn , AMSYS_TRN_SCRN_ID AS amsysTrnScrnId , AMSYS_QCMN_TXT AS amsysQcmnTxt , AMSYS_FAVT_NM AS amsysFavtNm , AMSYS_MENU_LEV_SEQ AS amsysMenuLv , DAT_USG_YN AS datUsgYn , FST_DB_RGS_ID AS fstDbRgsId , FST_DB_RS_DTM AS fstDbRgsDtm , LST_DB_CHG_ID AS fstDbRgsDtm , LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS lstDbChgDtm , CASE WHEN AMSYS_MENU_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END favtYn FROM SGEOWN.MSGE002ITM WHERE DAT_USG_YN = 'Y' ) A WHERE 1=1 -- AND (A.amsysMenuId = 'MNU00000000000000029' ) START WITH A.amsysMenuId = 'MNU00000000000000000' CONNECT BY PRIOR A.amsysMenuId = A.amsysHgrnMenuId ORDER SIBLINGS BY A.amsysMenuMarkSeq
query_info.data_query: SELECT '80000' AS "collapse_cd" , A.amsysMenuId AS "docid" , A.amsysMenuId AS "amsysMenuId" , A.amsysBizCfcd AS "amsysBizCfcd" , A.amsysBizDtlsClfId AS "amsysBizDtlsClfId" , A.amsysMenuMarkSeq AS "amsysMenuMarkSeq" , A.amsysHgrnMenuId AS "amsysHgrnMenuId" , A.amsysMenuHdYn AS "amsysMenuHdnYn" , A.amsysTrnScrnId AS "amsysTrnScrnId" , A.amsysQcmnTxt AS "amsysFavtNm", , LEVEL AS "amsysMenuLv" , SUBSTR(A.fstDbRgsDtm,0,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(A.fstDbRgsDtm,5,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(A.fstDbRgsDtm,7,2) AS "reg_dtm" ,SUBSTR(A.lstDbRgsDtm,0,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(A.lstDbRgsDtm,5,2)||'-'||SUBSTR(A.lstDbRgsDtm,7,2) AS "upd_dtm" , SUBSTR(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(A.AMSYSMENUNM, ' > '),4) AS "title" , SUBSTR(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(A.amsysMenuId, ' > '), 4) AS "menuIdPath" FROM ( SELECT AMSYS_MENU_ID AS amsysMenuId , AMSYS_BIZ_CFCD AS amsysBizCfcd , AMSYS_DTLS_CLF_ID AS amsysBizDtlsClfId , AMSYS_MENU_NM AS amsysMenuNm , AMSYS_MENU_MARK_SEQ AS amsysMenuMarkSeq , AMSYS_HGRN_MENU_ID AS amsysHgrnMenuId , AMSYS_MENU_HDN_YN AS amsysMenuHdnYn , AMSYS_TRN_SCRN_ID AS amsysTrnScrnId , AMSYS_QCMN_TXT AS amsysQcmnTxt , AMSYS_FAVT_NM AS amsysFavtNm , AMSYS_MENU_LEV_SEQ AS amsysMenuLv , DAT_USG_YN AS datUsgYn , FST_DB_RGS_ID AS fstDbRgsId , FST_DB_RS_DTM AS fstDbRgsDtm , LST_DB_CHG_ID AS fstDbRgsDtm , LST_DB_CHG_DTM AS lstDbChgDtm , CASE WHEN AMSYS_MENU_ID IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END favtYn FROM SGEOWN.MSGE002ITM WHERE DAT_USG_YN = 'Y' ) A WHERE 1=1 -- AND (A.amsysMenuId = 'MNU00000000000000029' ) START WITH A.amsysMenuId = 'MNU00000000000000000' CONNECT BY PRIOR A.amsysMenuId = A.amsysHgrnMenuId ORDER SIBLINGS BY A.amsysMenuMarkSeq
